title: Stade Velodrome: overview

description: Stade Velodrome stands in Marseille, France: a 67,394-capacity venue opened in 1937, home to Olympique Marseille. France's loudest ground. Stadiums are the cathedrals of sport — concrete memory banks where generations experienced the same joys and heartbreaks. This database covers the ground's history, architecture, great events, and how to visit it.

title: History
d: Stade Velodrome opened in 1937. France's loudest ground..
definition: Stade Velodrome opened in 1937. France's loudest ground..
description: The history of Stade Velodrome begins in 1937. France's loudest ground. Like all great grounds, it has been rebuilt, renamed, and reborn — stands rising where terraces stood, roofs arriving decades after the first kick. Its timeline is the timeline of its tenants' triumphs and the city's love affair with the game.

Renovations keep adding hospitality while trying not to dilute the soul.

title: The tenants

When the team thrives the stadium shakes; when it struggles the old ground groans with it. You cannot separate the venue from its people.
